level_systems.revised_label: Revised CDC Levels (Downshifted 8/14/26, use not advised)
level_systems.standard_thresholds: Very Low ≤2.0; Low >2.0 to 3.4; Moderate >3.4 to 5.3; High >5.3 to 7.8; Very High >7.8
level_systems.revised_thresholds: Very Low ≤2.6; Low >2.6 to 4.9; Moderate >4.9 to 7.9; High >7.9 to 11.6; Very High >11.6

methodology: Observed counties use median CDC site WVALs associated with the county after short-term site-level carry-forward. Current site values are used when available; prior-week site values are carried forward for counties with one or more sites; two-week-old site values are used only in multi-site counties that also have at least one current or prior-week site value. Counties without eligible local surveillance are estimated from nearby observed counties only using conservative bounded inverse-distance weighting. Estimated counties do not influence other estimated counties. Puerto Rico is entered manually from Puerto Rico wastewater reporting and converted to CDC WVAL format. Guam and U.S. Virgin Islands insets use current-week CDC territory/site WVAL rows when available; if the territory is offline in the current week but has prior-week CDC WVAL data, the prior-week territory value is carried forward. Current territory rows are never medianed with stale carried-forward rows. Public prevalence text is calculated as county WVAL multiplied by the user-entered PMC multiplier, capped in public display at >5.0% and at least 1 in 20 people. The output includes both Standard CDC Levels (through 8/13/26) and Revised CDC Levels (Downshifted, 8/14/26). The output also includes an 8-week county-level history array for each current row, calculated by rerunning the same county aggregation and missing-county estimation method for each of the most recent 8 COVID reporting weeks; each historical target week uses that week plus the two preceding COVID weeks for the same carry-forward rules.
